source_limitations: Official Oxford 3000/5000 CEFR PDFs directly inspected on 2026-10-31, with 1-based PDF page and zero-based extracted text line locators. Four dictionary pages observed via publisher-indexed search extracts, not independent human verification. Publisher word/POS CEFR is not exact-sense CEFR evidence; topic badges are not independently approved labels. Frozen shortlist and review flags unchanged; final George/Emma listening, physical iPhone, hosting and deployment gates remain absent.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: Connected with organising and managing office work.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: ရုံးလုပ်ငန်းစီမံခန့်ခွဲမှုနှင့်ဆိုင်သော
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: She handles administrative tasks for the team.

records.editorial_risk: Oxford 5000 labels administrative adjective C1, above provisional B2. It concerns organisational/office duties rather than management authority or an administrator as a person; independent exact-sense C1/B2 decision required.
records.independent_reviewer_task: Independent human editor must check the exact intended sense, source-backed CEFR level, English definition, idiomatic Myanmar, original-example grammar, British pronunciation and historical provenance; direct publisher word/POS evidence and self-authored proposals do not establish independent approval.

dictionary_sense_lead.sense_summary: Oxford adjective entry describes duties connected with organising the work of a business or institution; the draft administrative tasks example matches that domain, not administrative power.

editorial_rewrite_candidate.myanmar_meaning: အဖွဲ့အစည်းတစ်ခု၏ ရုံးလုပ်ငန်းများကို စီစဉ်ဆောင်ရွက်ခြင်းနှင့် သက်ဆိုင်သော

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: The appearance of something caused by how it reflects light.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: အလင်းရောင်ပြန်ဟပ်မှုကြောင့် မြင်ရသော အရောင်
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The colour of the sky changed before sunset.

records.editorial_risk: Oxford 3000 labels colour noun A1; directly inspected Oxford dictionary noun sense 1 also describes visible hue, and its Colours and Shapes a1 topic badge is a topic label, not independent exact-sense CEFR signoff. Provisional B2 is especially difficult to justify.
records.independent_reviewer_task: Independent human editor must check the exact intended sense, source-backed CEFR level, English definition, idiomatic Myanmar, original-example grammar, British pronunciation and historical provenance; direct publisher word/POS evidence and self-authored proposals do not establish independent approval.

dictionary_sense_lead.sense_summary: Oxford noun sense 1 describes the visible quality produced by light reflection, countable or uncountable; the draft sky example fits the basic sense, which has a Colours and Shapes a1 topic badge (topic tag is not independent exact-sense CEFR signoff).

editorial_rewrite_candidate.myanmar_meaning: အရာဝတ္ထုတစ်ခု၏ အလင်းပြန်ဟပ်ပုံကြောင့် မျက်စိဖြင့် မြင်ရသော အရောင်
